acceptance: Queue time and run time per required job are measured over at least 20 recent PR runs and recorded in this item.
The `continuing anyway` behaviour in the trunk arm gate has a written rationale or is changed, with a test for the chosen behaviour.
If runner capacity is the cause, the owner's decision on capacity is recorded here.
description:
Operational gap observed on 2026-11-12 across PRs #4169, #4175 and #4196. A full CI round took 60-90 minutes, most of it jobs waiting in the queue (required checks `core`, `docs` and `tooling` sat `QUEUED` after their placeholder failures; medium-test shards were pending for over 40 minutes). During one arm, `trunk-arm-gate` printed `the newest trunk.yml run on develop ... has been queued for 40 minutes (over 30), so develop may be unverified; continuing anyway` and the PR was armed. So a PR can be armed, and merge, on top of a `develop` head whose trunk verification has not run.

Not established: whether the queueing was runner capacity on that day or a standing limit, and whether the 30-minute warning was chosen deliberately as warn-only.

Expected: a recorded decision on the warning (keep warn-only with the reason, or refuse to arm past a stated age), and a measurement of where the CI time goes so the queue can be sized or the workflow reordered.

Guardrails: no change that lets a PR merge with fewer required checks; no skipping of the trunk gate. Runner settings and spend are owner decisions.
